policy: Bundle ceilings are 235000 raw / 71000 gzip bytes after the SVG and accessible-tabs refactor (measured 232606 / 70483; docs/v2/evidence/frontend-redesign.json). Local UI timing ceilings retain the original baseline and must be compared on the same machine/profile; CI enforces bundle size only. Budget changes require an explained new measurement. Catalog automation adds validated plugin metadata and health/recipe/result contracts. Shared generated schema objects reduce the measured raw bundle to 229577 bytes; gzip is 71309 bytes versus the prior 70483-byte baseline. The raw ceiling stays 235000; the gzip ceiling is 72000 to cover this measured contract expansion. The searchable shared icon registry and reusable uploaded-image picker add approximately 3 KB raw / 1 KB gzip; their measured build is 232501 raw / 72276 gzip. The raw ceiling remains 235000 and the compressed ceiling is 73000 for these additional controls. URL and server-local image imports with explicit cached live refresh add 3876 raw / 1195 gzip bytes to the prior icon build. Measured bundle: 236377 raw / 73471 gzip; ceilings are 240000 / 75000 to cover these new editor controls and ImageImport contracts. Timing budgets are unchanged. The contextual editor toolbar adds keyboard overflow actions, validated on-demand rename, protected root deletion and confirmation, and live save feedback. Measured bundle: 241288 raw / 74891 gzip, versus 236377 / 73471 before the toolbar change. The raw ceiling is 245000; gzip stays at 75000 and timing budgets are unchanged. The phone-access settings change was measured against the current HEAD baseline (including the simplified action editor): 257694 raw / 79675 gzip bytes, already above the previous stale ceilings. Browser LAN controls, immediate listener changes, QR display and NetworkSettings/NetworkStatus contracts produce 262943 raw / 81189 gzip bytes. Ceilings are 265000 raw / 82000 gzip; UI timing budgets are unchanged. The pairing request flow rewrites the pairing screen (named device request, polling claim, remembered device token) and adds the host-side PairingApprovals panel: measured 273004 raw / 83665 gzip bytes, versus 268803 / 82583 without the approval component. Ceilings are 275000 raw / 85000 gzip; UI timing budgets are unchanged. Unified device connections add invitation progress, trust/profile management, permission polling, network diagnostics, and the centralized reconnection controller. Measured production bundle: 294945 raw / 89178 gzip bytes. Ceilings are 300000 raw / 91000 gzip; UI timing budgets remain unchanged. Minimal full-screen deck retains the isolated practice controls and on-demand Driver.js 1.4.0 tour, accessible from the controls menu. Permanent workspace chrome was removed. Rebuilding HEAD on the same toolchain measured 338314 raw / 97210 gzip (above the prior ceilings). The current bundle, including Settings deletion protection and refined SVG icons, measures 370524 raw / 107577 gzip across both chunks. The tour chunk is approximately 20 KB raw / 6 KB gzip and loads only when requested. Total ceilings remain 375000 raw / 110000 gzip; timing budgets are unchanged. Flat settings add typed radio groups, steppers, switches, file cards, status badges, responsive navigation and a live preview, replacing native selects and disclosure sections. The measured production bundle totals 380064 raw / 110022 gzip bytes, compared with 370524 / 107577 before settings work. Ceilings are 385000 raw / 112000 gzip to cover this component system; timing budgets are unchanged. Compact Devices & Connections moves QR codes and diagnostics into on-demand dialogs and groups device/network controls into responsive columns. Together with the JSON catalog migration, the final bundle measures 384379 raw / 111442 gzip bytes. Existing ceilings remain 385000 / 112000; timing budgets are unchanged. The button editor redesign adds shared drag-and-drop file controls, a millisecond audio fragment editor with real decoded waveforms and browser preview, and optional native playback bounds. Same-toolchain production builds measure 384379 raw / 111442 gzip before and 404732 raw / 118166 gzip after (docs/v2/evidence/improvements/button-editor-bundle.json). Ceilings are 405000 raw / 119000 gzip; UI timing budgets remain unchanged. No dependencies were added. The complete bilingual tutorial catalogue adds 16 anchored guides, asynchronous navigation, contextual help and isolated examples. Production JavaScript measures 468496 raw / 135232 gzip bytes, versus 404732 / 118166 at 7778278 (docs/v2/evidence/improvements/tutorial-bundle.json). Learn, its runner and Driver.js load on demand. Ceilings are 470000 raw / 137000 gzip; UI timing budgets are unchanged. No dependencies were added. Shared action forms add lazy-loaded CodeMirror 6 for safe JavaScript/JSON editing, searchable native application targets, header rows, file sources and one shared switch. Same-toolchain production totals are 897277 raw / 281684 gzip bytes, versus 463833 / 134797 at bffd9e7. The initial main chunk is 432656 bytes; the 409497-byte CodeMirror chunk loads only when a code field mounts. Total ceilings are 900000 raw / 284000 gzip; timing budgets are unchanged. Measurements: docs/v2/evidence/improvements/action-forms.json. The unified connection dialog reuses the existing controls and adds browser device-name suggestions, request selection and countdowns without dependencies. Same-toolchain HEAD/working-tree totals are 897731 raw / 281757 gzip and 903562 raw / 283830 gzip bytes (docs/v2/evidence/improvements/device-connection.json). The raw ceiling is 905000; the gzip ceiling remains 284000 and timing ceilings are unchanged. Native tray status reuses the web catalogue, and settings/tutorial query links extend routing without new dependencies. Production JavaScript measures 904126 raw / 284044 gzip bytes, versus 903562 / 283830 at 6e5393b (docs/v2/evidence/improvements/windows-tray.json). The raw ceiling remains 905000; gzip is 285000 to cover the additional routing and status text. Timing ceilings are unchanged.
